title: Why becoming a Humand Business Partner is one of the best commercial decisions you can make today
summary: Discover why becoming a Humand Business Partner is the smartest strategic decision for consultancies, agencies and software companies today. Real data, partner cases and everything you need to know.
body_markdown:
## Why becoming a Humand Business Partner is one of the best commercial decisions you can make today


There are moments when the market gives you a clear signal. You don’t need to overthink it. You just have to decide whether you get on board or watch others do it first.


Companies are no longer looking for isolated tools. They want a solution that unifies internal communication, culture, HR processes, operations and employee experience in one place, from a mobile phone, without needing a corporate email address. And most of the consultancies, agencies and software companies working with those organisations still don’t have their own platform to offer them that.


That’s where Humand comes in. And that’s where the opportunity to become a Business Partner begins.


---


## What’s behind Humand: years of development you can offer today


Humand is not a simple solution. It is the all-in-one platform that connects the entire company on a single digital platform: internal communication, organisational culture, HR processes, operations and employee experience. All from a mobile phone, with a simple, intuitive experience designed for every employee, including frontline, warehouse and shop floor workers who don’t have a computer or a corporate email address.


With more than **2 million active users across 51 countries** and the backing of a **USD 66 million Series A round** ,[Humand](https://humand.co/en/) is today a platform with real market validation, global scale and a presence in companies like OXXO, The Home Depot, Sodexo, John Deere and Holcim.


Building something like this from scratch is not a matter of months. It is an investment of years and millions. Industry data compiled from thousands of projects shows that the average cost of developing a custom enterprise solution ranges from USD 100,000 to USD 500,000 for medium to high complexity projects, with maximum-scale enterprise platforms easily exceeding one million dollars. And that is before you factor in what comes after launch: annual maintenance of an enterprise platform typically represents between 15% and 25% of the original development cost, year after year, covering infrastructure, security, updates and technical support.


What Humand took years to build, you can offer today. Without developing anything. Without assembling your own technical team. Without investing in infrastructure.


That is exactly what it means to be a[Humand Business Partner](https://humand.co/en/partners/) .


---


## The market is moving: and the window won’t stay open forever


Companies across every sector — retail, manufacturing, logistics, construction, healthcare, services — are digitalising the way they communicate with their teams and manage their internal processes. The question is no longer whether they will do it, but when and with whom.


[McKinsey reports that more than 60% of companies plan to increase their technology investment, with growth expectations broadening even among mid-sized companies that have historically been more cautious.](https://www.mckinsey.com/industries/technology-media-and-telecommunications/our-insights/winning-b2b-customers-in-technology-and-telecommunications) Competition to capture that demand is intensifying and traditional acquisition channels are no longer enough.


In that context, the partner channel is positioning itself as the most efficient distribution engine.[According to Forrester’s Partner Ecosystem Marketing Survey, 75% of partner ecosystem leaders reported that their technology investments will increase over the next twelve months.](https://www.forrester.com/blogs/partner-marketing-automation-platform-pmap-investment-on-the-rise/)


And there is something else worth understanding: partner programmes of platforms that scale strongly are not open indefinitely. As the ecosystem grows, the programme becomes more selective and those who join first capture the greatest value. The early mover builds relationships, gains implementation experience and establishes a position before the market becomes saturated.


The question is not whether it is worth it. The question is when you are going to decide.


---


## Why partnering with a consolidated platform changes the rules of the game


Not all strategic alliances are equal. But the logic is consistent: partnering with a platform that already has market validation, an installed client base and brand credibility significantly shortens the time you need to build trust with your own prospects.


[According to Gartner, 67% of B2B buyers today prefer a purchasing experience without traditional sales representatives, relying instead on their own research and peer validation.](https://www.gartner.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2026-03-09-gartner-sales-survey-finds-67-percent-of-b2b-buyers-prefer-a-rep-free-experience) In that context, the credibility of the platform you sell becomes directly your own credibility in front of the client.


When you partner with Humand, you are not just adding a product to your portfolio. You are adding the credibility of a platform with a massive global user base and a presence in companies that are industry leaders. That changes how your clients perceive you and opens conversations you could not have before.


---


## AI is not the future: it is already the present. And Humand is at the forefront.


If there is one trend defining the technology market today, it is artificial intelligence. Companies without an AI strategy are already falling behind in their conversations with clients.


[Gartner predicts that 40% of enterprise applications will be integrated with task-specific AI agents by the end of this year, up from less than 5% the year before — an eightfold increase in just twelve months that is redefining what is expected of any enterprise platform.](https://www.gartner.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2025-08-26-gartner-predicts-40-percent-of-enterprise-apps-will-feature-task-specific-ai-agents-by-2026-up-from-less-than-5-percent-in-2025)


[Humand has Sammy AI](https://humand.co/en/humand-ai/) , its native artificial intelligence assistant that lives inside the same app your employees already use. Sammy answers questions about policies, benefits, leave and internal processes instantly, 24 hours a day, with the source cited. If the query goes beyond its scope, it automatically escalates to the right team. Configurable tone per company, segmentation by area or role, and an autonomous knowledge base. The result: **more than 3 hours saved per week per employee** and a real reduction in HR tickets.


This is not a feature add-on or a roadmap promise. It is AI in production today, inside a platform already used by large organisations worldwide.


As a Business Partner, you are not just selling a people management platform. You are selling a solution with real, measurable AI already deployed. That positions you at the most relevant conversation in the market today and differentiates you from any competitor still promising to implement AI “in the future”.


The rocket has already launched. The question is whether you will be on board.


---


## What some of our partners say about working with Humand


The best way to understand an opportunity is to hear from those who have already taken it. These are some of the experiences shared by partners who are now part of the Humand ecosystem.


[HL Global](https://humand.co/en/success-story/hl-global/) is a company with extensive experience in payment technology and software. Its CEO, Humberto Lozano, was looking to diversify his business lines and offer higher-value solutions to his clients. From the moment they joined the programme, the onboarding process was agile and well supported. Commercial materials accelerated the first deals and the Partner Executive’s support gave them confidence throughout every conversation. *“Humand’s modules cover every need. Clients really liked the product”* , Lozano says. Results came quickly: new commissions, higher client retention and faster deal cycles than with any previous solution. *“It has been one of the products I have closed fastest, and I am very happy about it.”* What started as a new revenue line became something more: *“They see us as a team that adds value. And we feel like part of the Humand team.”*


**eSource Capital** , a strategic partner of Google Workspace and Microsoft 365, faced a very specific challenge: their clients were asking for a solution that could reach operational staff without computers or corporate email, and the tools they handled could not deliver that. Humand was the missing piece. *“We decided to become Humand Partners to solve two major market pain points: connecting frontline workers without a desk and eliminating tool fragmentation across office teams.”* The impact on their business was immediate: new commercial opportunities in segments they could not previously serve, recurring SaaS revenue added to their business model, higher client retention and new cross-selling conversations within their existing client base. *“Adoption is so fast and organic that clients perceive the value of the investment within the first few months.”* *“Becoming a Humand Partner transformed our business by expanding our market to operational staff, generating new commercial opportunities and increasing client retention.”*


**Viamatica** was looking for an enterprise solution to integrate into their offering. When they found Humand, what convinced them most was the vision behind the product. *“Humand achieves something few platforms do: bringing the entire organisation together in one place, integrating people, processes and culture in a practical and straightforward way.”* Since joining, the results have been concrete: new commissions, an expanded portfolio and new cross-selling opportunities, especially with mid-sized and large clients where Humand naturally complements their payroll module. *“It has created a sustainable revenue stream and allowed us to design the roadmap to integrate our payroll system with Humand.”*


---


## What you get when you join as a Business Partner


[The Humand Business Partner programme](https://humand.co/en/partners/) is designed so you can operate from day one with everything you need:


**Dedicated Partner Executive:** a direct point of contact who accompanies you at every stage of the commercial process, from the first client conversation through to the close.


**Sales materials ready to use:** presentations, brochures, one-pagers and prospecting resources available from day one, in Spanish, English and Portuguese.


**Onboarding and certification:** a structured process so you can get to know the platform thoroughly and sell it with confidence and criteria.


**Post-sale CX team:** once the deal is closed, Humand’s Customer Experience team supports the implementation and ensures the client adopts the platform with real success.


**Recurring revenue in dollars:** commissions for every closed deal, with a scalable model and no mandatory initial investment.


---


## How to get started: it is simpler than you think


The process has four steps and is designed to minimise friction:


**1.** Validate the fit and the partnership model


**2.** Sign the Business Partner agreement


**3.** Certification and access to resources


**4.** Commercial activation


A clear process, with support, focused on results.


---


## A closing reflection


The market does not wait. Companies are already looking for solutions like Humand with or without your involvement.


The real question is not whether Humand is a good opportunity. The numbers, the real cases and the technology already answer that. The question is whether you will be part of this ecosystem now, while there is still space to position yourself, or later, when the market is already taken.


The best time to join something that is growing is always before everyone else sees it coming.
